title: Universaarl core master data plan
purpose: Define the first minimal Universaarl customers, vendors, items, locations and dimension/default-dimension needs before creating master data.
entryCriteria: UNIVERSAARL-DE exists and is active target company.
Global Dimension Code assignment is consciously parked by TARGET-024H.
Posting Groups and VAT setup are known as preflight/readiness areas, not final proof.
exitCriteria: First master-data records are named with purpose, required fields, dependencies and expected later entries.
No master data is created by the plan case.

lookahead.reason: Templates and required posting/VAT fields need inspection before actual customer/vendor/item creation.
VAT setup needs source-backed German setup choices.
Default dimensions can be defined once concrete master-data records exist.

nextStep: Plan first Universaarl master data without creating records yet.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-024H parked Global Dimension Code assignment. TARGET-024 converted the dataset blueprint into concrete first Universaarl customers, vendors, items and locations without creating records.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: The plan closes the dependency before master-data UI work: records now have purpose, codes and required preflight fields.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Card/template/mandatory-field evidence is required before any master-data record is created.
VAT fields on customers/vendors/items need source-backed German setup choices before final claims.
Default Dimensions can be planned after the relevant cards/templates are known, without claiming global dimensions.
First customer creation needs TARGET-025 proof plus number-series/posting-group readiness.
Vendor/item creation should not start before card/template and setup dependencies are visible.

nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It turns the local master-data plan into UI evidence while still preventing accidental record creation.
risksBeforeNextCase: Template dialogs may create records if confirmed blindly.
Posting groups, VAT groups and number-series setup are still not fully proven for all master-data cards.
Global Dimension Code 1/2 assignment remains parked and must not be used as a claim.
requiredPreparation: Use cancel-safe dialog handling and screenshot QA.
Capture card/list page context before any New/template route.
Stop before Save/Create if a new record would be generated.
